guide.what: Medusa events (an order placed, a shipment, a refund, a new account) become emails for customers and alerts for the store team, in the store's languages. Every email is logged with its status and can be sent again; texts and the look are edited here, without code.

install.title: Install the plugin
install.body: npm install, add it to plugins in medusa-config.ts and run npx medusa db:migrate.

provider.title: Connect sending
provider.body: Register the Resend or SMTP provider for the "{{channel}}" channel and switch demo mode off. In demo mode nothing leaves the store.

links.title: Set the links
links.body: storefrontUrl and adminUrl, so buttons in emails lead to the order in the store and in the admin.

team.title: Store team recipients
team.body: Addresses for new order, failed payment and low stock alerts ({{count}} set). On the Settings tab.

appearance.title: Match the look
appearance.body: Colours, font, buttons and logo on the Appearance tab, with a live preview.

texts.title: Review the texts
texts.body: On the Templates tab. Variables such as the order number are inserted with a click.

languages.title: Languages
languages.body: The store has {{count}} language(s). With the Translation module, each email can be translated.

test.title: Send a test email
test.body: Open any template and send a test to your address. Done once an email was really delivered to a provider.

production.title: Go live
production.body: Demo mode off, a verified sending domain, and a look at the History tab after the first orders.

guide.promptHint: Paste it into Claude Code, Cursor or another assistant in your Medusa backend project.

demoData.title: Demo mode: nothing is sent
demoData.body: Emails are rendered and logged with the status "Demo". "Restore test data" fills the history with a month of sample emails for your latest orders and customers: every type, sent, failed with the reason, pending and resent. Turn the demo option off in medusa-config.ts before going live.
demoData.resetBody: The sample emails in the history are replaced with a fresh set built from the store's latest orders and customers. Real history entries are kept, and nothing is sent.
